channel.title: Aurelia Vale — AV Collections
channel.description: Literary fiction and nonfiction by Aurelia Vale — written with care, published with purpose.

item.title: The Deeper Story — 50 Literary Fiction Writing Prompts for Serious Writers
item.description:
Fifty carefully crafted prompts for writers who want to go beyond the surface — into character, voice, memory, and moral complexity. Each prompt now carries a "Go Deeper" question for when the first draft feels too safe.

Sample prompt: "A woman clears out her mother's house after her death and finds a room she never knew existed. She doesn't tell anyone."

Available now on Lemon Squeezy — €4.99.

item.title: The First 40 Days — A New Mom's Guided Companion
item.description:
A warm, honest, day-by-day companion for new mothers navigating the most tender and overwhelming season of their lives. Forty days, each with a focus, body check-in, heart check-in, and one small action.

From Day 1 — You Did It: "You brought a new life into the world. That is enough for today."

Available now on Lemon Squeezy — €7.49.

item.title: Beneath the Same Sky — An Invitation to Understanding Islam
item.description:
A quiet, honest introduction to Islam, written in plain English for anyone who has ever wondered — without pressure, without argument, and with nothing to prove. Every Quranic reference sourced by surah and ayah; every hadith verified sahih or hasan.

From the Preface: "We live beneath the same sky, you and I."

Available now via Draft2Digital — $0.99.
